stepFreeCategory.category: A, Compliant step-free access to all platform(s)
stepFreeCategory.notes:
This is a Category A station. This station has step-free access to all platforms. The Passenger Assist meeting point is at the Information Desk on Concourse.

Please take care when boarding/alighting the train at all platforms at this station, as the stepping distance between the train and the platform may be more prominent than at other platforms.

bus.notes:
For details of bus services, visit Traveline Scotland or call 0141 465 1878 (24 hours)

The bus stop for ScotRail service 398 between Glasgow Central, Buchanan Bus Station and Glasgow Queen Street is located in front of the station on West George Street

From Monday the 10th August until Saturday the 15th August between 19:00 and 20:00 only, the bus stop for this service will change due to roadworks. The bus will be using the bus stop on West George St outside Stack&Still restaurant.
